decision.summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 0 to 1/4 percent.

changes.quote: Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened.
changes.explanation: The Fed highlighted that vaccinations and ongoing policy support are helping economic activity and the job market get stronger.

changes.quote: The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic remain weak but have shown improvement.
changes.explanation: Industries hit hardest by the virus are still struggling, though they are starting to recover.

changes.quote: Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.
changes.explanation: The central bank noted that higher inflation is mostly driven by temporary factors.

tone_quotes.quote: Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened.
The ongoing public health crisis continues to weigh on the economy, and risks to the economic outlook remain.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 14.65% APR costs about $61.04 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 1.63% and moved 0 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 3.04% would not change.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 6.1%, and employers added an average of 561k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.7% over the past year (March 2021); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.1%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 6.2% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved 0 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.08%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.11% on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that the Federal Reserve will maintain its current policy stance until substantial further progress is made toward its goals. Educational forecast models suggest an upcoming meeting hold is very likely at 92%.

citations.detail: The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent
